name: How can I add storage to a narrow hallway without making it feel cramped?

mainEntity.name: How can I add storage to a narrow hallway without making it feel cramped?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adding storage to a narrow hallway requires clever design choices to avoid clutter and maintain openness. Consider shallow, wall-mounted shelving, recessed niches, or custom built-in units that are no deeper than 10-12 inches. Wall hooks for coats and bags can also be practical. The key is to utilize vertical space and select slim-profile furniture or storage solutions that do not impede foot traffic. We often recommend custom solutions that seamlessly blend with the wall, maximizing utility without encroaching on the walkway.
acceptedAnswer.description: For narrow hallways, use shallow wall-mounted shelving, recessed niches, or custom built-ins to add storage without feeling cramped. Focus on vertical space and slim profiles.
